notes: Moto Guzzi V85 TT Euro 5, V100 and later applications. OEM/service and commercial material proves this is a CAN diagnostic controller and lists identification, DTC, learning and stored-data functions. No public Moto Guzzi 11MP CAN capture, ODX/PDX definition, CAN identifier pair, DID table or routine IDs were found. The old 0x7E0/0x7E8 plus K-Line-style 1A 80 definition was unsupported. Physical CAN sessions are blocked before sending a request.

can.note: No bitrate, CAN identifiers, addressing mode, or padding is claimed without a family-specific capture.

session.note: ISO-TP physical transport alone does not establish UDS/KWP services or identifiers.
session.physical_blocked_reason: ISO-TP transport, CAN identifiers, addressing, and diagnostic application payloads remain unvalidated.

identification.reason: No validated family-specific diagnostic application definition is available.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Unverified transport; no write path exists.

sources: Moto Guzzi Euro 5 service-station manuals: IAW 11MP application and diagnostic-tool procedures
